title: ArrowSpeedAndPower
description: Increases arrow projectile speed and range with every level of Power (adjustable)
body:
# Arrow Speed and Power (ASAP)

A lightweight plugin that scales projectile speed (and therefore range) with each level of Power. Arrow speed and damage scaling is configurable in config.yml.

If you encounter issues or have suggestions, please contact me on Discord: @euthanasia_enthusiast.
